{{Quote|Grunel was the founder and the real leader of the Sand panthers, and will always be remembered as such. But if I can help this way, then perhaps I will honor his legacy while creating my own.|Padnel Ovin|<ref name="Ascension" />}}
'''Padnel Ovin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinian]] freedom fighter who assumed leadership of the [[Sapience Defense Front]] following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his brother and predecessor, [[Grunel Ovin|Grunel]]. When [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] became a member [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], Padnel was chosen to represent the interest of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] as its first [[Senator/Legends|representative]] in the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] declared itself an independent power from the Galactic Alliance, the ruling [[Triumvirate (Galactic Alliance)|Triumvirate]] collapsed, and thus the Senate was forced to re-institute the suspended [[Office of the Chief of State]].

In the Senate's rush to stabilize the executive branch of the government, Padnel Ovin was elected as the new [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] of the Galactic Alliance. Despite being hastily sworn into office, Ovin was well aware that his voters simply chose him because of their desire to control the executive branch by electing a powerless figurehead. As a result, he selected former triumvir [[Wynn Dorvan]] as his [[Chief of Staff/Legends|Chief of Staff]]. He also aligned himself with the clandestine organization known as [[Club Bwua'tu]] to strengthen his fragile hold on power.

Despite Chief Ovin's steps to consolidate his new role, his administration was extremely short-lived. The [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sentience/Legends|entity]] known as [[Abeloth]] killed Ovin in a bid to take his place as leader of the Galactic Alliance. Disguised as [[Rokari Kem]], a senator of the planet [[Qaras]] who had been absorbed by the entity, Abeloth used Kem's popularity and her own [[Force power/Legends|powers]] of [[Mind trick/Legends|persuasion]] to become the next elected Chief of State of the Galactic Alliance.
